evidence.quote: On the inside, in both landscape and portrait,
For sheets on the inner display, the system presents the toolbar horizontally for centered or leading placements, and vertically for trailing placements.

evidence.observed: Centered inner-landscape sheet render uses horizontal header.

evidence.quote: On the inner display, they're centered by default,
sheets placed on the left remain without a vertical bar,
while sheets placed on the right receive one.

conflicts.interpretation: The overview is broad; the bar-focused official video explicitly distinguishes inner sheet placement, consistent with developer documentation. This is a difference in scope, not mutually contradictory requirements.
conflicts.decision_policy: Use centered/leading horizontal and trailing vertical references only with established container conditions. The specialized bar video and developer document agree; the overview video summarizes the default centered case. If the relevant condition is not established, omit the orientation-failure claim and continue reviewing visible defects; do not output needs_confirmation labels.
conflicts.resolved_by_runtime: A runtime can establish observed configuration, not turn a bug into official compliance. Keep the official design guidance and empirical result separate.

conflicts.title: 控件外形、热区及默认/最小尺寸不能混用

evidence.quote: As a general rule, a button needs a hit region of at least 44x44 pt

conflicts.resolution: Buttons指button hit region；Accessibility区分默认44x44与最小28x28。默认截图不测数值，专项测量先明确对象、运行时热区、阈值和例外，不能统一用28替代44。

conflicts.title: 通用水平栏描述与Duo专用侧栏

evidence.quote: A toolbar consists of one or more sets of controls arranged horizontally
In general, don’t override the default bar placement.

conflicts.resolution: Duo特定形态与容器指导优先；其它平台的水平栏、visionOS竖栏禁用等不能套用Duo。保留宽文字、自定义视图及sheet例外。
